title: Incentive Strip
description: A row of store promises — shipping, returns, secure payment — composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading and a short line over a list of incentives, each an icon in a muted tile, a title, a sentence and an optional policy link, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — two incentives per row with the icon above its text at @sm, a larger heading at @md, and all four on one row with more room above and below at @lg.
